creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-05 on the devenv, twice in one session: `muster pane close fudge` and `muster pane read llama` each failed with clap's usage error, and the agent needed a `--help` round trip to learn the pane goes in `--pane`. Still so on 0.22.0:

    error: unexpected argument 'somepane' found

    Usage: muster pane close [OPTIONS]

    For more information, try '--help'.

`muster msg post --to <name>` and the muster skill's examples make a bare pane name read as though it would work.

Costs: one wasted call per verb an agent has not used before.

Possibly: accept the pane as an optional positional on the pane verbs (close, read, compact, restart, wait), or have the usage error name `--pane <ref>`.
title: pane verbs refuse a pane named as a positional, and the usage error does not point at --pane
